Hi team,

Quick renewal housekeeping for NimbusTech (DEAL-4591) ahead of the finance gate on Friday:

- Please confirm the Q3 committed ARR in the attached sheet (NimbusTech_Q3_commit_sheet.xlsx) by EOD Thursday. We need the clean number for the forecast refresh.

On Tue, May 21, 2028 at 09:12 Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick renewal housekeeping for NimbusTech (DEAL-4591) ahead of the finance gate on Friday...

Thanks Marcus — quick update:

- I've added a row in the attached commit sheet marking a 20% ARR exposure on the analytics seat line. Usage has declined ~35% last 30 days versus trailing 90; last activity spike was three weeks ago.
- Root cause: the customer paused a product integration (internal delivery delay) which temporarily reduced inference volume. They told us the integration is slated for mid-June, but that's not firm.
- Risk posture: Medium — we can recover if integration resumes. If it doesn't, we should expect a partial scale-back.

Action items:
- Marcus: suggest scheduling a 20-min health check with Lara to confirm integration timeline.
- Ben: can you escalate SOW/discount asks if they try to reduce seats? Procurement might push for credits given the paused integration.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Hi Marcus / Naomi,

Thanks for the heads up and for the sheet. Confirming the integration pause — our internal eng team delayed the rollout last week. Tentative go-live is now June 18, but that date isn't fully committed.

We want to avoid surprises on renewal. Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a short-term usage credit if integration slips past June?
2) We need the SOW updated to reflect phased seats by module — Ben, can you share the revised SOW?

Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow 10:30am PT to sync.

Regards,
Lara Singh
Head of Platform Partnerships, NimbusTech
lara.singh@nimbustech.com

Thanks Lara — appreciate the clarity. Recap and next steps: 

- Call scheduled: Thu 2028-05-22 10:30am PT (20 mins) to confirm integration timeline and any interim remediation.
- Ben: please prepare a one-page SOW addendum that outlines phased-seat pricing + an interim credit policy (if integration slips beyond June 30). Attach SOW draft to this thread before the call.
- Naomi: we'll mark the analytics seat row as "at-risk" in the forecast unless we see usage rebound by June 10. Finance will apply a conservative probability for the gate.

I'll attach a clean copy of the commit sheet and the current SOW for Ben to redline. If Procurement needs contract-level approvals, loop legal.

Thanks all — see you on the call.
